decision: The competitor (Alfa Romeo Racing ORLEN) is fined €800.
event_name: Date 24 September 2021 Time 15:33 2021 RUSSIAN GRAND PRIX 23 - 26 September 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
